axis: +Z points into the engine; z = 0 at the terminal end of the body

parts.name: Body: M10×1 stainless bolt, drilled Ø5
parts.note: An M10×1.0 hex bolt, 28 mm long, drilled through Ø5.0 on a lathe or drill press. The thread seals into the engine; the hex takes a spanner.

parts.name: Copper crush washer
parts.note: Annealed copper: crushes to seal against the engine boss.

parts.name: Insulator: alumina tube Ø4.8 × Ø1.7
parts.note: Single-bore alumina (thermocouple-sheath tube). 20 mm outside the body to stop the spark flashing over the ceramic.

parts.name: Centre electrode: Ø1.6 Kanthal / tungsten wire
parts.note: Oxidation-resistant alloy wire, 1.5 mm proud of the ceramic. The bead at the end takes the HV lead crimp.

parts.name: Ground strap: 1×3 mm nichrome / stainless
parts.note: Welded (TIG or spot) to the face of the body and bent over the tip. The gap under it is set with a feeler gauge: 0.8 mm.
